# Sheep & Wolves

> A free, real-time social deduction party game played in person on everyone's phones — no app download required.

Sheep & Wolves is a browser-based party game for 3 to 30 players, in the same tradition as Werewolf or Mafia. One player hosts a game and shares a short code or QR code; everyone else joins from their own phone's browser. Roles are dealt secretly — most players are sheep, a hidden few are wolves. The group discusses out loud, face to face, then votes each round to eliminate a suspected wolf. Sheep win once every wolf has been voted out; wolves win if they ever equal or outnumber the remaining sheep.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sheepandwolves.app/): Overview and entry point to host or join a game.
- [How to Play](https://sheepandwolves.app/how-to-play): Full rules, round-by-round walkthrough, and FAQ (setup, player counts, tiebreakers, win conditions).
- [Host a Game](https://sheepandwolves.app/create): Create a new game and configure player count, wolf count, and discussion timer.
- [Join a Game](https://sheepandwolves.app/join): Join an existing game using a code or QR code.

## Notes

- Free to play, no account or app download required.
- Designed to be played in person — everyone uses their own phone for roles and voting, but discussion happens face to face in the same room.
